log.msg: Root cause: sustain launches Servex with `node --import Servex/Crumbs.js`; Node workers inherit --import, so each CrumbsWatch.js watchdog worker re-ran Crumbs.install() (the globalThis.__crumbs guard is per-isolate) and spawned another worker. Unbounded worker chain: crumbs.log shows `start pid=` every ~30 ms and rss at 8 GB just before each exit 134. Introduced by dbcde67f0 (Crumbs lag watchdog).
Pool heal/restore was NOT the cause (the brief's prime suspect): main-thread heap stayed 6 MB in every heartbeat; the memory was native worker memory.

Fix committed 5af4f5188: Servex/Crumbs.js install() returns unless isMainThread. node --check OK. At 09:16:33 Servex came up as pid 32304 on the new code; crumbs.log shows normal operation, no start spam. Verifying it stays up 5 minutes.
